description:
## Goal

Make `RuntimeDemand(E)` an ordinary change-driven fact formula and delete the whole-cone product calculation. A newly discovered callable edge becomes one exact dependency and contribution; it never causes standing values to reset and replay from bottom.

This is the main proven cold-compilation hotspot and the central spreadsheet-model repair after product state survives across requests.

## Boundary with InputDemand

`RuntimeDemand(E)` is executable materialization demand. `InputDemand(F)` is source-function activation-key precision and is converted separately by `fz-kdt.213`. They remain distinct fact keys, values, producers, and readers. They may reuse generic World fact/contribution plumbing, but they do not share a cone, SCC solver, dirty index, bridge, or compatibility path. `fz-kdt.165` extends InputDemand; it does not add a RuntimeDemand dimension.

## Recorded signal

On `00420_enum_take_drop_split`, one cold debug-interp request produced eight demand-cone settlements: two one-member cones, four 198-member cones, and two 204-member cones. The large cones each climbed 17 rounds and ran 1,028 or 1,068 member derivations; `external_members` was zero throughout. A debug sampling profile placed roughly one quarter of captured main-thread stacks within runtime-demand production.

`produce_runtime_demand_product` collects a transitive cone, settles every member from bottom, discovers actual callable-flow edges from the result, and may discard and repeat the calculation. One product key therefore hides a program-scale unit of work.

## Correct model

- `RuntimeDemand(E)` has one FactKey, one authoritative World slot, and one producer formula.
- A formula waits for executable facts to appear settled, then reads their Current content, its Current exact input-contribution cell, and Current RuntimeDemandInputs cells for exact direct-call or callable targets named by typed evidence. Recorded absence is bottom; no formula waits for a peer demand to become settled. A retained root explicitly owns the executable-need seed for its exact entry and retracts that seed with its lifecycle; there is no formula-local Whole fallback when the last caller disappears.
- Callable capture correlation has no aggregate or parallel authority. A direct `CallableTarget` or first-class `CallableConstructionTarget(owner, value, surface)` yields one exact ExecutableKey. Its activation inputs carry the correlated capture-plus-surface identity, and its RuntimeDemand carries the exact input demands. The formula reads only those target cells, so roots and unrelated specializations cannot contaminate or wake each other.
- A formula with no live owner and bottom demand publishes no outbound target contribution; exact replacement retracts its former frontier.
- Before every peer cell exists, an owned formula publishes its provisional `RuntimeDemand(E)`, exact direct return contributions derived solely from caller-local use, and an exact first-class owners executable-need return contribution as soon as its construction-target fact exists. It waits only for missing Current target presence before publishing peer-dependent capture/input contributions. A formula with no owner publishes no outbound contribution. This seeds acyclic callees without a bottom-only round and bootstraps self and mutual cycles without a settled-peer dependency or a Whole fallback.
- Each caller owns replaceable contributions to exact target cells. Retraction removes only that caller contribution.
- Cyclic convergence comes from ordinary content-changing wakes and transitive settledness.
- Artifact and transport consumers wait on settled demand facts.
- A dormant persistent root session receives resulting fact movements through exact subscriptions.

`RuntimeDemandInputs(E)` is a sub-fact view of the single stored `ExecutableRuntimeDemand(E)`, not a cloned value or second producer. The same DeriveRuntimeDemand conclusion reports the full-value change and input-vector change independently: return/value-only movement revises only `RuntimeDemand(E)`; input movement revises both keys; equal input revises neither input sub-fact nor its readers. Static peer discovery and callable capture propagation read Current exact `RuntimeDemandInputs(target)` cells; artifact and full-value consumers continue to read `RuntimeDemand(target)`.

## TDD and telemetry acceptance

1. Acyclic, self-recursive, and mutual-recursive formulas converge with exact contributions, provisional bottom publication, and no settled-peer waits.
2. Callable-edge addition, replacement, and retraction preserve unaffected values and evaluate only exact target readers. Cross-root target reads remain disjoint, and a formerly reached executable returns to bottom after its last owner retracts.
3. Same persistent root and unreachable redefinition evaluate zero demand formulas; a reached edit evaluates only the transitive reader closure.
4. Every non-initial evaluation names moved content. Readiness-only movement causes zero demand calculation. Equal conclusions do not revise facts or wake readers.
5. Several scheduler orders produce identical semantic facts, causal work multiset, backend program, and three-door output.
6. No cone, round, SCC, root, or executable-inventory scan occurs; acceptance uses deterministic work, never a wall-clock threshold.

Before deleting cone telemetry, census `external_members` across the full matrix. Any observed external/displacement path becomes a focused retraction/finality test; if none is observed, delete the path with its owner.

## Required deletion

- `collect_demand_cone`, `settle_demand_cone`, `DemandConeRetryGuard`, `DemandGraph`, `SettledDemandCone`, and `actual_flow_edges`;
- demand-specific dirty sets and reverse indexes;
- PullSession return/input contribution, contributor, joined-demand, callee-inventory, and bespoke invalidation maps;
- whole-cone publication/replay telemetry and atomic-product documentation;
- temporary shadow facts, compatibility bridges, and comparison harnesses.

Run focused fact/scheduler/product tests, full library, serial fixture matrix, both large target fixtures on all doors, cross-process determinism, formatting, check, strict clippy, and docs. Rewrite fact-engine, pipeline, semantic-fixpoint, performance instrumentation, and `northstar.html` around the ordinary reactive formula and record every removed authority.

## Retained-root return boundary

The RuntimeDemand cutover and the retained-root return boundary are one atomic step: base reactive facts already invalidate and re-drive exact product readers correctly, while RuntimeDemandInput and DeriveRuntimeDemand exist only after this ticket. Add a focused retained-session RED that holds a cached root, moves an exact leaf RuntimeDemand input from Ignore to Whole, and proves the resulting DeriveRuntimeDemand wake is drained before return. The returned artifact must retain the exact current settled demand and corresponding Whole-dependent layout; affected product generations must reproject, equal reproduction must do no demand/product work, and no ready work capable of changing the requested root may remain. Use existing exact queues and dependencies—no global quiescence scan, blanket rerun, or second queue.

## Callable target identity boundary

`CallableConstructionTarget(owner ExecutableKey, local ValueId, grounded CallableSurface)` is one exact demand-driven World fact whose value is the canonical target ExecutableKey. Its sole producer reads settled current ExecutableFacts(owner), resolves that local construction’s function and complete capture-type vector, waits on the callee function’s Recursive and InputDemand facts, and only then mints and publishes the exact canonical target. Owner redefinition replaces or retracts the fact; equal reproduction preserves its revision and wakes nobody.

DeriveRuntimeDemand reads Current only for the exact grounded construction-target keys its semantic derivation demands. While a construction target is absent, it publishes provisional RuntimeDemand and caller-local direct return contributions, withholds only the affected first-class contribution, and waits for that exact fact. Once the fact exists it publishes the exact owners executable-need return contribution and reads the targets Current RuntimeDemandInputs sub-fact for peer-dependent capture/input demand. It never mints a type, structural address, or activation key and never scans callable publishers, activations, executable inventories, or speculative surfaces. Direct call edges continue to use their settled CallableTarget evidence.

The immutable Ty-to-RuntimeDemandTypeProjection memo is World-owned and shared by ExecutableFacts construction and RuntimeDemand reads. RuntimeDemand evaluation is lookup-only; it cannot mint identities.

Focused construction-target acceptance covers static escaped bootstrap, an arbitrary late grounded surface, self and mutual bootstrap, independent surfaces, exact missing-prerequisite waits, owner replacement and retraction, equal reproduction without revision or wake, unchanged RuntimeDemand formula identity inventory, and absence of contributor scans or speculative target minting.


## Exact capture-row correlation

Capture correlation uses exact target provenance. Direct callable demands already carry typed CallableTarget keys; first-class demands name exact CallableConstructionTarget keys. Each target activation carries its capture-plus-surface frame, while its RuntimeDemandInputs sub-fact exposes the input vector of the one stored RuntimeDemand value. Reading one exact target can reveal further live local callables or surfaces, so the same formula follows only those newly named target keys in a finite local dependency-discovery loop until its typed read set stops growing. The standalone-addressed raw capture prefix is not an authority: a precise capture Ty can legitimately key to an erased activation-frame Ty. No raw capture-prefix fallback remains.

## Exact delivered-lane consequence

Removing the cone anchor also removes its unrelated `ExecutableNeed::Value -> Whole` return widening. A directly selected clause may therefore project only the fields its caller consumes: for `Enum.count`, the statically known `:ok` tag is `Ignore`, the integer payload is `Whole`, and backend/native transport carries exactly one `RawInt` lane. Tests prove the complete demand-to-layout-to-adapter chain instead of pinning an incidental aggregate lane count. Boxed first-class owners still contribute their exact executable-need return demand independently.

## Deleted callable-input aggregate signal

On `00420_enum_take_drop_split`, the temporary root-and-function callable-input aggregate refolded 434 times and emitted 273 wake signals; 22 of 30 trace-correlated projection-caused RuntimeDemand completions reproduced their whole answer. Exact callable targets already carry the correlation that aggregate reconstructed. A further 252 whole-peer completions reproduced their entire answer, while at least 156 aggregate cross-product signals connected unrelated owner capture brands. The final model therefore deletes `RuntimeDemandCallableInput(s)`, its key/fact/contribution store/refold/fanout. Input-only peer readers address exact `RuntimeDemandInputs(ExecutableKey)` sub-facts, eliminating both the aggregate fanout and return/value-only peer wakes without introducing another stored authority.

## Retained edit causal proof

For the focused retained-root edit, each exact RuntimeDemand reader in the transitive leaf-to-main/other closure evaluates exactly twice: once when its owned ground retracts and once when the replacement fact reappears. The prior 4/3/3 work multiset included readiness-only repeats; the ordinary Current-after-presence subscription removes those repeats, yielding 2/2/2 without changing the exact reader set or output. A Settled ExecutableFacts(E) wake may therefore conclude with Current ExecutableFacts(E) as the formula standing read: this is one exact fact one-way presence transition, not a different dependency or an inventory replay.

## Canonical construction-target telemetry

Raw `CallableConstructionTarget` events retain their typed owner/value/surface identity. The `surface` array contains Ty ids and is registered and substituted through the public trace's type dictionary exactly like `surface_tys`; raw typed keys remain the in-process authority, while canonical text exists only for display and cross-process comparison. The deterministic causal-work gate observes direct `DeriveCallableConstructionTarget` formula/fact work and deletes every stale `callable_resolution` product count or identity assertion.

## Full-matrix external-member census

Before deletion, exact old HEAD `7f2bcc2dede4a07b064a48916f024bc9a0f61bf0` ran all 515 non-deferred fixture paths through run/interp/build serially and observed 1,708 `fz.compiler2.demand.cone.settled` events. `external_members` was zero in every event (`max=0`, `nonzero=[]`). The raw command, census definition, and result are retained in `.agent/measurements/fz-kdt.4-external-members-census.txt`; no external/displacement path or owner survives the cutover.

## Deterministic causal-work ratchet

The final `00420_enum_take_drop_split` cold request performs 1,278 `DeriveRuntimeDemand` evaluations in total, of which 1,039 start from exact changed-revision wakes, over 311 distinct RuntimeDemand/construction-target formula keys. The gate pins all three exact counts and keeps the pre-existing work split fixed at 1,730 non-demand changed-revision starts plus 1,140 non-demand blocked expansions. These explicit formula counts replace—not rebaseline—the removed cone's 6,250 hidden member derivations; they are causal-work invariants, not wall-clock claims.

## Sparse tuple-demand invariant

A tuple-field demand is a finite demanded prefix: omitted trailing fields are semantically , while every present index remains positional. Transport projects that prefix against the exact immutable tuple Ty and supplies  layouts for omitted trailing fields; only a demanded index beyond the exact tuple arity is an arity mismatch. This preserves partial structural transport without widening to . The  regression pins the complete boundary:  with  remains four positional layouts , keeps the input unboxed, and retains the three-allocation/144-byte result across run, interp, and build.
title: Replace RuntimeDemand cone replay with reactive per-executable facts
